mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate trend over the past 3 months compresses the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as bond yields rise and equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and an increase in non-farm payrolls signals a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through a positive earnings channel.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a sustained economic expansion phase (as indicated by quarterly GDP growth above 2.0%), the S&P 500 exhibits positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to rising corporate profits and investor confidence in the business cycle.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly housing starts exceed 1,200,000 units, it indicates a robust housing market that stimulates consumer spending and business investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment improves rapidly.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where HOUST exceeds 1,200.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand that accelerates economic growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through a positive demand shock.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST and RSAFS rising fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (as indicated by FEDFUNDS above 4.5%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to higher borrowing costs and reduced corporate investment.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production trend over the past 3 months indicates strengthening manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO has increased by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months.
